The decisive mistake was FinancialData_Expert's approach at step 0. It relied on a CSV file (`apple_stock_data.csv`) that it never obtained and assumed already existed. It never retrieved any real Google Finance data or looked for another source. Every later run failed with `FileNotFoundError`, and the other agents only repeated the request to download the file manually. No data was ever retrieved, so the answer of 2018 was never found.
